clone_root: (temporary clone of the repository, removed after the run)
repo_gate_chain_note: tests/run_gates.sh (G3 verify_repro, G4 verify_pipeline, G5 gate_registry, G6 gate_change_control, G7 gate_ontology_layer, G8 gate_ontlayer_portability) run inside the clone with the documented precondition environment (EYEKB_G3_PY / EYEKB_MODEL_DIR / EYEKB_CORPUS)
corpus_note: the retrieval corpus is a release asset, not a repository file (README quickstart step 2), so a clean clone cannot run G3 without it; the unpacked asset on this machine is named here so the clone run is comparable to the author run
gate_info_note: M16 CLEAN-CLONE is reported as INFO inside this invocation: the clone check is the step that produces the record M16 judges, so the author-tree invocation judges it
files_not_distributed_note: files the repository git-ignores (the pipeline's binary work products) are skipped rather than reported as missing: a clone cannot contain them by construction
ledgers_and_logs_exclusion_reason: ledgers/ and logs/ are runtime output that this chain rewrites while it runs; they are excluded from both the manifest and this comparison on purpose
how_the_clone_was_run: git clone --no-hardlinks file:///home/ubuntu/EYEKB_REPO, checked out at the commit under test; both the repository's gate chain and this wave's gate executed inside the clone
